# E-PM2 peaking-mf owner camera test

The owner reports peaking in normal MF live view and a clean post-shot preview on the rebuilt firmware.

**physical camera; reported pass; complete report; reported hash.**

**Camera:** [Olympus PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md) · **Project:** [EPM2Mod](../projects/epm2mod.md)

**Firmware:** [E-PM2 firmware 1.6, build 1600](../firmware/epm2-1600.md) · **Mod build:** peaking-mf

**Expected manifest SHA-256:** `6a47806dfafce15d281358eae2beffe397132e5999c50b28c69b2a2467efcf39`. This does not establish the installed package identity.

## Procedure and coverage

The owner flashed the rebuilt firmware and checked MF peaking during live view, half-press and review. They also checked S-AF, the 2× digital teleconverter and movie mode.

- Peaking stops at half-press, stays out of the post-shot preview and returns afterwards.
- Peaking appears with the 2× digital teleconverter. No lines were seen in S-AF or movie mode.

## Limits and assumptions

- One owner and one camera. The log identifies the flashed firmware image. The installer archive was not independently checked.
- The first candidate showed peaking lines in the post-shot preview. This result is for the rebuilt image.
